name: Purpose and Scope of this Policy
text: This Privacy Policy is issued by {{company_name}} ('the Company', 'we', 'us') and applies to personal data collected through {{website_url}} and related services. It describes how we collect, use, store, and protect personal data — including {{data_categories}} — for the purpose of {{processing_purpose}}, in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Information Technology Act, 2000 and rules made thereunder. This Policy is effective from {{effective_date}} and applies to all users and data principals whose personal data we process.

legal_basis.note: Notice must state the personal data collected and the purpose of processing
Body corporate must publish a privacy policy describing data handled

invalid_if: Categories of personal data collected are not stated
Purpose of processing is not stated
title: Purpose and Scope
dispute_hotspots: Vague or open-ended purpose — DPDP notice must be purpose-specific
